dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid-pixel clusters; most high-intensity pixels are constrained to the thin perimeters of the macro-annuli. Minor clusters of solid high-intensity pixels are localized on the lower anterior margin and as sparse flecks on the posterior dorsal midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the two central oval rings form a vertical baseline. An obtuse triangle is formed by connecting this baseline to the centroid of a large anterior-lateral ring. Including the centroid of a diffuse 'C' shape on the mid-posterior dorsal surface extends the geometric relationship into an irregular quadrilateral.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-contrast orange-red linear mark is located on the posterior-most extremity, exhibiting a sharp color variance relative to the rest of the observed surface.
